verification_report.summary:
The proof is correct relative to the expressly accepted prerequisites. The sequential audit contains 20 statement records and 104 deduction checks, with no critical errors or gaps. The report results/relative_class_domination_01/verification.json became available during this audit and was read in full: its verdict is correct. It supports finite rooftop closure, ordered stretch closure, the uniform positive lower mass bound, and strict domination with finiteness specifically for the smaller potential's measure. The earlier conditional dependency is therefore resolved relative to those accepted inputs.

The extraction argument preserves the exact convex-envelope definition of E_phi. Model-envelope equality and Hartogs supply the uniform upper bound relative to phi; one translation normalizes the sequence, and fixed-measure exponential integration permits one extraction with summable self-errors and smooth-volume almost-everywhere convergence. On each finite roof, the first-contact pieces form a disjoint partition. Ordered contact bounds each piece by the corresponding restriction of the same nu. Summing gives mu_{p_{j,N}}<=nu with coefficient one, independently of the number of obstacles, while the weighted error is at most 2^(1-j).

For each fixed real B>=1, stretch closure gives genuine r_{j,N} in E_phi, with kappa<=mu_{r_{j,N}}(X) and mu_{r_{j,N}}<=B^n nu. Choose K using B^n nu({u<=-K})<kappa/2, and only then choose j so B^n 2^(1-j)<exp(-K)kappa/4. Both choices are independent of N. The exponential test yields sup_X r_{j,N}>=B log(exp(-K)kappa/(4 B^n nu(X))) for every N>=j. Thus the decreasing tail limit R is genuine and satisfies all tail inequalities. No class membership of R is assumed.

For every defining parameter b>=1, taking B=2b and averaging R with the stretched finite-prefix roof S gives a genuine theta-psh H satisfying H/b+(1-1/b)phi<=u_l for every index l of the extracted sequence. The b=1 construction first proves h genuine. For arbitrary b the same convex sum is a competitor below h, making H a defining b-competitor for h. The starting index and competitors may depend on b; the extracted sequence stays fixed. Pole sets are handled through convex sums and canonical representatives. Consequently h belongs to E_phi, and h<=u<=phi gives u in E_phi by upward stability.

For dominated continuity, every monotone passage has the genuine lower bound h. Weighted lower semicontinuity first gives mu_{p_j},mu_p<=nu and hence finiteness, then gives the zero exponential-error integral. The inequalities from the tail construction imply p<=u, and the zero integral implies mu_p({p<u})=0. Strict domination applies with smaller potential p, whose own measure has already been proved finite, and yields p=u. The upper tails decrease to u, so the envelope sandwich proves capacity convergence along the extracted sequence.

The fixed domination supplies the uniform total mass bound, and h<=u_j gives uniform raw-tail control by nu({h<=-T}), tending to zero because h is genuine and nu ignores pluripolar sets. These are exactly the hypotheses of the accepted raw-tail continuity theorem. Every original subsequence has a further subsequence converging in capacity to u and weakly in raw measures to mu_u; the subsequence criterion proves both convergences for the entire original sequence, with mu_u<=nu. No rooftop of that entire original sequence is asserted.

Full-statement theorem searches were followed by web fallback and primary-source inspection. The attribution matches Lemma 4.2 and Theorem 4.1 in [ALS26 v1](https://arxiv.org/html/2511.02339v1#S4), including its convex-envelope class and smaller-background model definition. The supplement explicitly uses a weaker extraction formulation and does not import the source's stronger original-sequence rooftop assertion or its compressed index manipulations. No novelty claim is assessed.

No upper-volume bound, BMP, or finiteness of every E_phi member is used. The particular upper mass bounds come from nu; positive v_minus(theta) supplies noncollapse, directly here and through the audited domination prerequisite. The book was left read-only, and hashes of the three inspected prerequisite chapters/sections are unchanged.
